title: OR-normalization preserves semantics
statement: Let $c$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables and let $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \bbf_2$ be an assignment. Then the normal-form OR circuit obtained by OR-normalizing $c$ computes the same Boolean value as $c$ itself: evaluated at $x$, it agrees with the value of $c$ at $x$.
replaced:
For every circuit $c$ and assignment $x$,
$(c.\mathrm{toNOr}).\mathrm{eval}\,x = c.\mathrm{eval}\,x$.
